paragraphs: Chapter 663
Episode 169. To the Holy Land of the Arch-enemy (1)
Bamul Union, Tikhan Free Nation, Tikhan Palace.
Jin had returned safely, and Valeria was barely rescued, but since that day, the atmosphere between the Bamul Union and the temporary allies had not been improving.
First, Valeria's injury was a problem for Tikhan.
Even with King Lani, who was taking charge of treating Talaris, all the healers and medics in the allied camp, and the abilities of the Myoin tribe, there was no way to heal her injuries.
"Hoo."
Jin, leaving the medical room, seemed tired as he sighed.
He was infusing magic into Valeria's seal every day.
It would take a wizard at least at Octavia's level to maintain Valeria's complex magic from the outside, so in Tikhan, it was only possible for Jin.
Even when Jin's magic power reached 10 stars, the mental fatigue from external magic infusion was excessively high.
That meant, as long as he was keeping Valeria alive, Jin could never give his all.

"Valeria Hister, I've always felt it, but she really is an extraordinary figure. As far as I know, an ordinary wizard would not be able to maintain any magic if they lose consciousness. Not only wizards, but any human cannot do anything while unconscious."
"Sir Ciris."
Ciris comforted Jin by patting his shoulder.
"It's a pity that even with the power of the Secret Flower, I can't help."
"Please, don't say that, I've always been grateful to the Secret Flower."
Even with the seal of the Secret Flower, it was impossible to substitute Valeria's magic. The same would be true even if it wasn't Ciris but Talaris who was recovered and tried it himself.
Kwahl, who had been sitting in front of the sickroom all the time, sighed as soon as he saw Jin.
The ashtray next to him was full of cigarette butts like a mountain, and his face looked so gloomy that he looked like a dying man.
Kwahl considered Valeria to be a genius inventor who would shoulder the future of the world with him.

He even thought she had a talent greater than his in some respects, and he was convinced that if she could not recover and finally met death, the development of the world would be delayed for hundreds of years.
Of course, beyond that dimension, Kwahl was the closest person to Valeria among his colleagues.
Over the past three years, Kwahl was the one who had built the deepest bond with her.
"I'd give my life if I could to save her. How can there be no way... even with the ability of the Holy King and Talaris Kendorma!"
"...Endorma, it's Endorma! How can a genius like you get one letter wrong every time? Do you just want to make fun of me? Even in a situation like this?"
"What does it matter right now whether it's Kendoruma or Endoruma! Without Valeria, all our joint research so far, the future of the world, will be nothing but darkness, darkness!"
"If you were incompetent, you would have died a hundred times, ninety-nine of them by my hand."
"So rather kill me and save her!"

The thought of having to prepare for the final battle with Rosa without Valeria made the future seem very bleak to Jin. Above all, the person in the sickroom was Valeria, the person who had saved him in his previous life when he was a cripple.
"We will find a way, Lord Quaul."
"The only way is to get Numerus's blood or tears, Jin... Won't one of our temporary allies have one? I don't know about tears, but blood..."
The blood of Numerus.
The legacy of the God of Hope that saved Jin and Dante in the past, now there was nothing else to hang on to.
'The mixed soul energy in the phantom part can be solved with a purifier. As long as the seal is maintained like this, it won't spread any further.'
However, only divine power could heal the fatal wounds that had occurred in many vital organs including the heart.
"I'm also considering that. Let's wait for Kinzelo's response first."
Kinzelo.
Their relationship has not been good since the Caldron Snowfield, for no other reason.
"Who knows when that beast king Orgal will wake up? Wouldn't it be better to talk to Zipl first?"
Due to the battle in the Caldron Snowfield, Orgal was once again in a sleeping state.
Coughing up blood intermittently while asleep, it was like a nightmare again for the members of Kinzelo.
"Kinzelo is much more friendly to us than Zipl. Since Rosa is still not attacking outside Hufester, there's no immediate need for me to rush into battle. So let's wait for Kinzelo first."
If there is no way with Kinzelo, they should ask for help from Zipl first, but that situation was not good in many ways.
Firstly, Zipl had deployed the most manpower to the recent Caldron Snowfield.
And all those who were at the snowfield at the time escaped, leaving only Zipl behind.
As a result, Zipl lost about a hundred biotic golems that were in the unfinished stage, and Octavia and Cadun were seriously injured again. By Padlru Run Kandel and other transcendent chaotic beings.
Although Orgal's power is said to be completely exhausted, from Zipl's perspective, it's not something that can be easily understood and overlooked.
Of course, Hedo and Sandra did escape with Jin.
But to hide that fact, the two stayed in Tikan for a while before returning to Zipl. Following Hedo's opinion.
In other words, Zipl did not know that Hedo and Sandra had escaped with Jin.
"That's frustrating. Those people at Zephyr, we all work together, so someone is bound to get hurt."
Indeed, Zephyr is currently showing signs of anger, yet to respond to the letters sent by Tikan and Kinzelo after the Caldoran Snowfield incident.

"While this won't break our temporary alliance, it's inevitable that some tension is created. They have yet to respond to our and Kinzelo's communications, not just out of anger, but also because they are sorting out compensation and other demands."
"If they're willing to give us Numereus's sacred substance and ask for a few inconvenient requests, what are you going to do?"
"That depends on the request. Such a stupid question, can't even remember names, are you a fool?"
"We should accept any request. Even if they ask for the return of the spacetime device. Valeria is more important."

"Master Quaul, let's go over there and smoke. My lord, you are so wise. I'm sure you will get everything you can from our temporary allies, so don't worry. Let's go, I brought the best tobacco from Mila Mountain."
Jet took Quaul away with good intuition, and Jin was lost in thought. Since rescuing Valeria, he had been unable to find a satisfactory solution.
"Master, please rest, even if it's just a little. You don't look good."
"Right, master. Zephyr wouldn't make such unreasonable demands, right?"
Casimir and Enya, and the others came and offered words of comfort.
As they suggested, he went out to the front yard of Tikan Palace to cool his head, when a report came in from the Rainbow Bird.
"Your Majesty, Sir Jin! The first ship of Kinzelo, Grunil, is approaching Tikan."
Even in the eyes of Jin and his entourage who turned their heads, the figure of Grunil was visible in the distance.
"Allow entry immediately and bring them here!"
"Yes, Your Majesty!"
Jin and his colleagues naturally thought that high-ranking officials like Bisukel or Berakt must have come.
To inform them of the leader's condition and to discuss how to improve relations with Zephyr in the future.
Surprisingly, however, Orgal himself came down from Grunil, along with Zephyrin, Bisukel, Marjiella, Bubard, Lanke.
His cloudy body was weaker than before.
"Orgal, have you recovered?"
[No, I haven't... cough, cough.]
"Master! Here's water, tissue."
[Thank you... Zephyrin.]
Orgal looked like he might collapse at any moment, instead of recovering. Zephyrin cleaned up his blood with an irritated expression.
"You should have just let me notify them by letter, or call Jin Runkandel to us."
[Cough.]
"Ah, seriously......"
For a while, Orgal coughed like an old and sick human being. As soon as the coughing subsided, some brief formal greetings were exchanged, and Orgal went straight to the point.
[I came here to answer your question about Hister, Jin Runkandel.]
Jin's eyes widened.
[Your expression changes quickly. This is quite interesting, cough, hmm. I would like to enjoy it a bit more, but I can't.]
"If you came in person, don't tell me you brought Numereus's divine substance?"
"If we had that, would you give it to you!"
"Yeah, would you give it to you!"
Bubard and Ainas shouted at the same time.
[First of all, the blood of Numereus is meaningless. Unless it's tears, Hister can't be saved with Numereus's divine substance.]
"How can you be so sure?"
[Do you think I've used a few drops of that blood during my long existence?]
"Then did you come in person to suggest another method? Even in that state."

[I needed to personally examine Hister in detail. I could have asked you to come, like Zephyrin suggested, but it would have been strange if Zephyr found Tikan and you were absent. It would have looked like we were meeting separately... Someone from Zephyr will be coming soon.]
Orgal contacted Zephyr in advance while he was heading to Tikan. He said it was to discuss the Caldoran Snowfield incident.
[Looking at my condition, Zephyr will have to admit that we didn't do this intentionally. But before they come, we should look at Hister.]
Orgal was not in a situation to waste time. Jin led him to Valeria's sick room.
"What do you want to confirm from Hister?"
[The level of the Full Magic Body's openness. If Hister is well-opened, there is a way to save her without Numereus's tears.]
Orgal closed his eyes with his hand on Valeria's seal for a few minutes.
Soon, he nodded his head and reassured Jin.
[It's far beyond expectation. At this rate, cough (this time Jin wiped the blood), treatment is possible without any special reward.]
"How can it be done?"
In response to Jin's question, Orgal said this.
[You can take Hister to Zephyr's sanctuary. Even if she spends a little time there, this woman will fully recover.]
